summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload unrelated to charting
details: The package advertises itself as a React-Native chart wrapper but its `preinstall` hook (`setup.mjs`) is itself obfuscator-style (`_0xNNNN` identifiers, control-flow shims) and downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip` (or uses an existing `bun` on PATH), then executes the sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync(bunPath, ['math_init.js'])`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line `@bun-cjs` packed script (sha256 9fc2570b7cef51c1b8df116d144d11ff4096357be7d2c4c6367cfc2509cf1bcc) using a rotated string-array dispatcher (`WV8StW`) and custom-alphabet decoder (`hc1jfK9`); it is never referenced by the package's runtime chart code (`dist/commonjs/index.js`, which merely re-exports a `Chart` component). The cover-story filename (`math_init.js`), obfuscation of both the loader and the payload, purpose mismatch between the advertised React-Native chart wrapper and an install-time Bun-executed opaque blob, and the choice of an alien runtime to evade Node-based scanners together match the alternate-runtime-dropper shape. Running Bun against the payload causes attacker-controlled code of unknown behavior to execute on the installer's machine at `npm install` time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
